restoration: VS Code account-synced customization; restore by signing in and allowing the agent customization sync to repopulate data/agent-plugins. The nonce-named cache folders are intentionally not copied.
notes: VS Code currently generates plugin folder IDs and nonces; do not hard-code them in a restore script.
MCP server authentication and account sign-in are not included in this repository.
The snapshot records configuration shape only; confirm current server access and account policy before enabling these servers.
